title: The Keeper's Light
summary: A lighthouse keeper learns the dead follow her beam, and a boat is steering for it.

beats.text: The infected follow light, and my job is the lighthouse.
I'm Ilsa. I keep the light on Skerry Head, a rock beside Port Ellis.
"Any boat at sea, steer for the Skerry light. Pier Four sails at dawn."
beats.speaker: announcer

beats.text: Down the causeway, shapes drifted toward my beam like moths.
Two hundred steps to the lamp. I climbed them at a run.
If I switched off, the dead would lose me. So would every ship.
Out on the black water, one small lamp blinked. Someone was steering for me.
"Skerry light, I have forty people aboard. Keep it burning."
beats.speaker: oren

beats.text: Then the tower door boomed below. The first of them had reached the end of the causeway.
The lamp flickered. The generator coughed once. Then my beam went out.
